meta.name: standup
meta.description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总多个分支或PR的变更，生成统一计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个工作分支间快速同步变更并制定合并计划
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate changes across branches or PRs into one consolidation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly sync changes across multiple work branches and create a merge plan

howto.what: Claude 会让多个 git 分支/工作树/PR 在共享聊天中轮流发言，比较改动与冲突，最后给出合并方案（以谁为基础、合并顺序、需你决定的事）和通俗总结。全程只读，不直接改动代码。
howto.when: 当你想跨多个 git 分支、工作树或 PR 比较改动，并想要一个统一的合并方案时。它会先列出候选名单（最近活跃的工作树/分支/PR）让你确认，至少两个候选才会开会。

say.text: 帮我对这几个分支和 PR 做一次只读 standup，给出一份整合计划。
say.note: 各分支先在共享聊天中发言，最后产出合并计划。

say.text: 按最近24小时活跃的工作树召集 standup，我看看要怎么合并。
say.note: 自动筛选候选名单，确认后开始召集。

say.text: 只比较 worktree A、分支 B 和 PR #12，讨论冲突并给结论。
say.note: 手动指定参会者；少于两个就停下。

howto.what_en: Claude convenes your branches/worktrees/PRs in one shared chat; they compare changes and conflicts, then it outputs a single merge plan (target, order, decisions) plus a readable summary. Read-only throughout.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want one merge plan across git worktrees/branches/PRs. It lists candidates (active worktrees/branches/PRs) and needs at least two to run; otherwise asks to broaden.

say_en.text: Hold a read-only standup for these branches and PRs; give me one merge plan.
say_en.note: It opens the facilitator chat and returns one plan.

say_en.text: Gather worktrees active in the last 24h; I want a consolidation plan.
say_en.note: It filters candidates, confirms with you, then starts.

say_en.text: Compare only worktree A, branch B, and PR #12; discuss and conclude.
say_en.note: Manual roster; fewer than two stops.
